hero_tagline: The 😒 unamused stare, the 😤 steam-before-it-boils-over face, and every kaomoji for 'I'm not mad, just annoyed.' Click any symbol to copy it instantly.
intro: The unamused face 😒 is the internet's go-to for low-grade irritation — the look you give when something is annoying but not worth a full meltdown. This page rounds up that whole mid-tier range: the flat 😑 expressionless stare, the sarcastic 🙃 upside-down face, and the 😤 steam-from-nose look for when annoyed starts sliding into frustrated. It adds the nonverbal side too — a 🤷 shrug or a 🙅 flat 'no' says 'I'm over it' without a single word, and text-based kaomoji like (￣ヘ￣) round out the set for places emoji don't render. For the specific act of rolling your eyes, see the eye-roll page linked below; for when annoyed boils all the way over into rage, see the angry emoji page.
